title: He and she verb sort
subject: Arabic
source: Seeded from arabic/y6 lesson 16 (Pupil PDF worksheet: he and she verb sort)
intro: Lesson 16: Vocabulary from the dialogue: what she does. To understand and use present-tense verbs for 'she' from the dialogue

questions.model: Teacher: يَطْبُخُ is 'he cooks'. Swap the ي for ت: تَطْبُخُ, 'she cooks'.

questions.q: Verb sort and write on the pupil PDF: sort ten verbs into 'he' and 'she', then write four sentences about women in your family using 'she' verbs. Start: أُمِّي ...
questions.a: Correct sort and four sentences with correct 'she' verbs
questions.model: Teacher writes: جَدَّتِي تَقْرَأُ القُرْآنَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.

questions.q: write a sentence with one 'he' and one 'she' verb.
questions.a: For example: أَبِي يَعْمَلُ وَأُمِّي تَطْبُخُ

questions.q: Back to our ponder: how do you tell he or she from the verb?
questions.a: يَـ for he, تَـ for she
